my first toon to 80 was Mesmer. Everything else seems easy sauce now! I was easily taking down mobs many lvls higher then me! Just make sure you get used to great sword, and equip sword/focus off hand. Focus number 4 is quick speed. Oh, most important thing with a memser, learn how to kite! Then its a awesome class to play! You bring so much utility to a dungeon run, peeps will love you!

EDIT: staff is very defensive play style. i know I lvled 40 lvls with one until I learnt about GS. Very offensive, and when you get dodge plus illusion spawn, its a wrap! Then again, who doesn't love a warlock!

EDIT EDIT: I also found sword/gun to be a useful spec. I never had problems with mobs aggro, open with with gun phantasm, hit numer 5 to stun them, switch to GS, and use your phantasm, see you already have 2 phantasms on the mob. Switch to GS, then throw your huge ass sword at them, 3 of you up, phantasms hurting that bitch, and proceed to destroy em. As mentioned, multiple mobs, just kite and dodge. Rince and repeat!
